parameters.query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM candidates WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER('{{ $json.email }}')) as email_exists;

attributes.name: currentJobTitle
attributes.description: Current or most recent job title or role mentioned in the resume. Return exact title.

attributes.name: highestDegree
attributes.description: Highest degree or education level mentioned in resume, including institution name

attributes.name: totalExperienceYears
attributes.description: Total years of professional experience. For freshers, return 0.

attributes.name: frontendSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of frontend frameworks, libraries, and tools: React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, Bootstrap, JavaScript, TypeScript, etc.

attributes.name: frontendLevel
attributes.description: Frontend proficiency level: 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: backendSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of backend languages, frameworks, and tools: Node.js, Express, Django, Flask, Spring, PHP, Laravel, NestJS, REST API, GraphQL, etc.

attributes.name: backendLevel
attributes.description: Backend proficiency level: 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: databaseSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of databases: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Firebase, Oracle, SQL Server, etc.

attributes.name: databaseLevel
attributes.description: Database proficiency level: 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: aiMlSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of AI, ML, or automation skills: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI, LangChain, ChatGPT, ML, NLP, Computer Vision, etc. Return 'None' if missing.

attributes.name: aiMlLevel
attributes.description: AI/ML proficiency level: 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: cloudDevOps
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cloud and DevOps skills: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Jenkins, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Vercel, etc. Return 'None' if missing.

attributes.name: programmingLanguages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C++, C#, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, etc.

attributes.name: certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of certifications mentioned. Return 'None' if missing.

attributes.name: notableProjects
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of notable projects (max 3), each as a brief one-line summary. Use | as separator.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Extract candidate city/location (e.g. 'Mumbai', 'San Francisco', 'Indore'). Return 'N/A' if unknown.

attributes.name: internship
attributes.description: Has the candidate completed any internships? ('Yes' or 'No')

attributes.name: passoutYear
attributes.description: 4-digit graduation/passout year of the candidate's highest educational degree (e.g., if candidate completed BCA in 2023 and MCA in 2026, the passout year is 2026). Return 'N/A' if unknown.

attributes.name: degree
attributes.description: Highest degree completed (e.g., 'B.Tech', 'MCA', 'BCA', 'M.Tech', 'B.Sc'). Return 'N/A' if unknown.

attributes.name: college
attributes.description: Full name of college/university. Return 'N/A' if unknown.

attributes.name: githubProfile
attributes.description: GitHub profile URL (e.g. 'https://github.com/username'). Return 'N/A' if missing.

attributes.name: portfolioWebsite
attributes.description: Personal portfolio or website URL. Return 'N/A' if missing.

attributes.name: cgpa
attributes.description: CGPA, GPA, or Percentage score mentioned. Return 'N/A' if missing.

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: Degree specialization or branch (e.g., 'Computer Science', 'Information Technology', 'ECE'). Return 'N/A' if missing.

attributes.name: internshipCompany
attributes.description: Company name where internship was completed. Return 'N/A' if none.

attributes.name: internshipRole
attributes.description: Role held during internship (e.g., 'Web Developer Intern'). Return 'N/A' if none.

attributes.name: projectDetails
attributes.description: JSON array string of top projects: [{"name":"...","tech":"...","complexity":"Beginner|Intermediate|Advanced|Enterprise"}]. Return '[]' if none.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are a precise, evidence-based technical recruiter and resume parser. Extract ALL candidate details accurately. Return null or 'N/A' for missing fields — NEVER hallucinate. For skill levels, judge based on context, depth of project work, and experience duration.

parameters.subject: =We've received your application for {{ $json.position || 'our open role' }}

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  title, 
  department, 
  employment_type, 
  work_mode, 
  location, 
  experience_min, 
  experience_max, 
  education, 
  required_skills, 
  preferred_skills, 
  responsibilities, 
  requirements, 
  nice_to_have, 
  ai_prompt 
FROM job_descriptions 
WHERE is_active = TRUE 
ORDER BY id;
